title: Receipts logged after a check: one dated the day before is judged by `told`, one dated two days before stays inside the check (AM3, H1)
story: Set up Thu 10 Dec 2026 in Tokyo, pay day: the bank holds 400,000, of which Free to spend 60,000 (typed). Pay of 300,000 on the 10th (moved earlier). Mon 14 Dec: Jun checks in at 10:00: 380,000. At 12:00 the same day he finds two receipts in his wallet and logs both from the bank on Free to spend: 4,000 for Sun 13 Dec and 6,000 for Sat 12 Dec. A check holds the events dated more than a day before its day; those dated on its day or the day before are judged by `told` [AM3]. So the 4,000 (the day before, told after the check) comes after it and is taken off the figure, while the 6,000 (two days before) is inside the check, whatever its `told`, and shrinks the filler. One phone, one zone. Every amount is made up.

events.note: Jun: a receipt from Saturday, logged after the check; two days before its day, so inside it [AM3]
Jun: a receipt from Sunday, logged after the check; the day before its day, judged by told [AM3]

asks.question: bank_today
asks.why: 380,000 (check, Mon 14 Dec 10:00) - 4,000 (the receipt dated Sun 13 Dec, the day before the check's day, told 12:00: after the check, taken off [AM3]) = 376,000
asks.note: The 6,000 dated Sat 12 Dec is two days before the check's day, so it is inside the check and not taken off, whatever its `told` [AM3]. Before AM3 both receipts were read as inside the check (dated before its day): 380,000.

asks.question: not_explained
asks.why: 400,000 (opening, Thu 10 Dec; the pay of 10 Dec is in it) - 6,000 (the receipt dated 12 Dec, inside the check) - 380,000 (check, Mon 14 Dec) = 14,000
asks.note: Before AM3: 10,000 (the 4,000 of 13 Dec read as inside too).

asks.question: headline
asks.why: 60,000 (Free to spend at the opening) - 14,000 (the filler of Mon 14 Dec) - 6,000 (12 Dec) - 4,000 (13 Dec) = 36,000
asks.note: Each receipt is counted once. Before AM3: 60,000 - 10,000 - 6,000 - 4,000 = 40,000, with the 4,000 neither off the bank nor in the filler.
